mapper.insert: INSERT INTO return_request (order_id, order_item_id, user_id, product_id, merchant_id, reason, status, type, reason_type, refund_amount, merchant_remark, reject_reason, user_evidence_urls, return_address_id, return_receiver_name, return_receiver_phone, return_address, actual_refund_amount, logistics_no, logistics_company, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{merchantId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{type}, #{reasonType}, #{refundAmount}, #{merchantRemark}, #{rejectReason}, #{userEvidenceUrls}, #{returnAddressId}, #{returnReceiverName}, #{returnReceiverPhone}, #{returnAddress}, #{actualRefundAmount}, #{logisticsNo}, #{logisticsCompany}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM return_request WHERE status = 0 AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT r.id, r.order_id as orderId, r.order_item_id as orderItemId, r.user_id as userId, r.product_id as productId, r.merchant_id as merchantId, r.reason, r.type, r.reason_type as reasonType, r.status, r.merchant_remark as merchantRemark, r.reject_reason as rejectReason, r.user_evidence_urls as userEvidenceUrls, r.return_address_id as returnAddressId, r.return_receiver_name as returnReceiverName, r.return_receiver_phone as returnReceiverPhone, r.return_address as returnAddress, r.refund_amount as refundAmount, r.actual_refund_amount as actualRefundAmount, r.audit_time as auditTime, r.receive_time as receiveTime, r.refund_time as refundTime, r.create_time as createTime, o.order_no as orderNo, u.username as userName, u.nickname as userNickname, p.name as productName, p.cover_img as coverImg, oi.specs as specInfo, oi.quantity as quantity, oi.product_price as itemPrice FROM return_request r LEFT JOIN `order` o ON r.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as waitReturnCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as returningCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as waitRefundCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejectedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN actual_refund_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalRefundAmount FROM return_request WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM return_request WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 4
